text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - The CCC said it bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. corn for donation to North Korea.
BARLEY SALE - The Cyprus Grain Commission accepted a tender from Soufflet Negoce for 25,000 tonnes barley at $156.87 per tonne. Shipment was set for May 1997.

WHEAT SALE - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd bought a combined 23,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday from Japanese trading house Mitsubishi Corp. Cheiljedang bought 9,000 tonnes and Dongah Flour purchased the remaining 14,500 tonnes. Shipment was set for June 1-30 to Pusan.
- South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills bought 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp. Shipment was set for June 20-July 20 to the port of Inchon.
WHEAT SALE - Jordan early Friday bought a total of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, U.S. exporters said.
The wheat was divided into two lots, one for delivery in May and the other in June, the exporters said.
CORN SALE - Private exporters reported the sale of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. corn to unknown buyers for delivery during the 1996/97 marketing year, U.S. Agriculture Department.
WHEAT TENDER - Philippines rejected bids for 25,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from the U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second shipment was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, the Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will tender on Saturday for 315,000 tonnes of soft white wheat from the United States or Australia for May 20-June 10 shipment.
SUNOIL TENDER - The CCC was tendering on May 7 for 3,000 tonnes of U.S. crude sunflower seed oil for export to Mozambique, June 1-20 shipment.
RICE TENDER - Jordan seeks to buy 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice for delivery in June, traders said. The closing date for offers is May 21.
